what_happened: In stop-and-go traffic the ego crept forward at about 1 m/s while drifting right across the lane line, heading toward the queued vehicles in the right lane (actor 21 and the parked/queued cars). It ended 3.4 m off the human path and made front contact with a vehicle in the adjacent lane. The lead vehicle in its own lane was still 4.3 m ahead.

The ego was going about 4–5 m/s behind actor 12. Instead of following the route (command switched to RIGHT, recorded path stays right), it drifted left by about 2.2 m into the next lane toward actor 15. Its side then hit actor 56, which was coming up in that lane just behind it, so this is a lateral collision during an unforced lane change.
